title: Notifications emitted from a system-context run (schedule tick, approval node) are stored with `organization_id` NULL on 18.0.0-next.0: the platform's own WARN says reports and cleanup that filter by organization will not see them
body:
Filing gate ①: a defect with a named producer, measured.
`reach:` named producer: any app whose scheduled flows or approval nodes notify, measured on the HotCRM app (single-organization install, ADR-0131 D3).
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 07). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage.
Reader: the objectstack triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states, "notify no organization in scope, sys_notification rows organization_id NULL from schedule tick or system run, approval.requested" → 1 hit, #10153 (closed, the `manager` approver's organization screen), which is a different defect.

## What happens (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0, HotCRM, fresh database with demo staff)

Let the 14:00Z hourly tick run `case_sla_monitor`, then read `sys_notification` as admin:
- 16 `case_sla_breach` rows, 11 of 12 `urgent_task` rows and all 5 `approval.requested` rows have **`organization_id` NULL**.
- Rows emitted from user-driven flows carry the organization: `quote_created`, `lead_converted`, `account_approved`, `opportunity_approved`, `large_deal_won`.
- Per emit, the server logs: "WARN [notify] no organization in scope for topic 'case_sla_breach' — the sys_notification / sys_inbox_message / sys_notification_receipt / sys_notification_delivery rows for this emit will carry organization_id = NULL and will be invisible to any report or cleanup that filters by organization … the triggering context lost its tenant".
- The inbox messages themselves carry the organization (28 rows, all set), so users still see them.

Screenshot (the Setup record, where the organization field is hidden; the evidence is the counts above): [07-system-run-notifications-null-organization.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/c859284c96a0e2e698bf0c5f4157f2bab6e57bca/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/07-system-run-notifications-null-organization.png).

## Ask

A notify issued from a schedule tick or another system run, and the approval node's `approval.requested` emit, carry the organization of the record they are about. Under ADR-0131's "organization ownership is total", no notification row is organization-less. The producer is in `service-messaging` / `service-automation` / `plugin-approvals` (the dev's attribution; the owning lane confirms). HotCRM only declares the notify nodes.
